profile.headline: Software Engineering Manager at RegEd
profile.summary: Specialties: Product Management, Data Analysis, Full Stack development, Rapid Prototyping, Mobile, Cloud and SaaS Development, Product Definition, Monetization, VOD platforms, Content Management, e-Commerce, Product Strategy and Planning, SDLC, Agile Methodology, Java,  .NET, MVC, Oracle and MS SQL Server, Clinical Trial data sets, Security and Identity Management, Payment Processing platforms.

positions.title: Software Engineering Manager
positions.description: Skills: Software Management · Engineering Management · Leading Development Teams · Software Solution Management · Technology Leadership

positions.title: Product Manager, Director
positions.description:
Technical product manager for Medfusion's payment processing SaaS platform.  Performed data analysis leading to new business strategy. Constructed UX/UI wireframes and User Stories based on customer interviews. Coordinated NPI across business areas, including contracts, compliance, security, pricing, and revenue projections. 

Developed proof of concept code for Identity Management and SSO vendor selection using SAML and OAuth. Java-based Open Source stack plus JBoss and Oracle 11g. Wicket and AngularJS Responsive Front end.  Product team member driving end-to-end vision and delivery of SaaS product roadmap serving ambulatory and community medical practices.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led the re-architecture of EmergingMed’s Clinical Trial Matching SaaS.  Extended the backend architecture to allow clinical trial searching based on a patient’s genetic profile. Data model extended to include a biomarker encoding scheme.  Leveraged multiple external data sources including clinicaltrials.gov data sets, ICD-09, Histology, and Topology codes. 

Designed and implemented Web front end using jQuery, Javascript, CSS, C# and .Net MVC 4/4.5. Designed and implemented REsTful web services using .NET 4.5 Web API and Oracle 10g.

positions.title: Applications and Data Analyst
positions.description:
Principal software engineer for several .NET applications fronting MS SQL Server. Automated the collection, aggregation, and linking/matching of electronic medical records from several EHR vendor platforms for major radiology practices and research organizations.  Designed and coded mission critical algorithms, matching and linking a 3+ million record patient registry with the North Carolina Cancer Registry.  The aggregated data is submitted to the national Breast Cancer Surveillance Consortium on a regular basis.

Designed, implemented and delivered critical security related product enhancements in time to prevent the Carolina Mammography Registry from being shut down by UNC.  Travelled to member practices across the state to personally upgrade their systems.

company.name: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill

positions.title: VP Product Engineering
positions.description:
Built multi-site project management and quality assurance teams pursuant to the development of multiple versions of the Joost video distribution and video ad serving SaaS platform. Java-based Open Source technology stack. 

Product areas included video content ingestion and metadata management software, video serving platform,  video advertising services, website, web and iPhone players.

Joost was acquired by Adconian Media Group, New York in 2009

positions.title: Senior Engineering Manager
positions.description:
WebLogic Server product and release manager working across multiple geographic development sites, totaling 100+ people, successfully delivering several WebLogic product family releases. Java Web Application Server, Product Management, Release Management.

BEA was acquired by Oracle Corporation in 2007.

positions.title: Software Engineer, WebSphere Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Technical Lead and/or Engineering Manager for several major subcomponents of the WebSphere Application Server product during its initial conception and releases.  

Technical lead and senior developer for several IBM product areas including a mobile and network computing device built using Java as the desk/palmtop on top of an embedded UNIX and XFree86 stack and PPC hardware, an early Windows-based MPEG-2 digital video streaming product, a distributed customer call system, and an internal SCVM platform. 

Java Web Application Server technology, Database design and analysis, MPEG video streaming, C/C++, Windows Web and Rich client application development.
